summary: SM Energy Co filed an 8-K reporting the redemption of its 6.75% Senior Notes due 2026 for $419,235,000 plus accrued interest, pursuant to the indenture documents. This is a routine debt repayment event, not a special situation. There is no change of control, shareholder return, or strategic transaction. The notes and guarantees were cancelled upon settlement. This is a pre-existing obligation being satisfied as scheduled.
